source.title: [PROTO-001][P0][wide-research] Deliver traceable prototype parts and sourcing matrix
source.body:
Work integration 2026-11-18 / WORK-INT-002. Research assignment, NO FORMAL CLAIM. Complements #2 (actual topology), #4 (modes), #6 (OVP); does not replace them.

Owner role: Chat B. Prioritize real parts over further hypothetical topology sensitivities. Deliver one bounded manufacturer/distributor evidence matrix covering (1) exact neon/DC data and IN-12B document provenance + socket/pin mapping, (2) at least two credible controller+magnetics pairs or explicit reason no pair qualifies, (3) protected 21700 and cell-attached NTC sourcing candidates, (4) HV output capacitor effective Cmin/Cmax, rating/ripple/ESR, OVP/discharge and HV connectors, (5) staged low-voltage PWR/CTRL vs standalone HV draft BOM. Cite exact MPN/revision, conditions, verified stock date, JPY tax/shipping/lead time or UNKNOWN, footprint and qualification hold. No present controller-only listing counts as a proven HV stage.

Exit: reviewable initial prototype BOM with missing costs/technical proof explicit, initial spending target <=JPY40k and reserve JPY10k tested as a budget (not asserted met), long-lead dependencies and substitutes identified, shared interface preserved where possible. Chat C batch review required before Work part adoption. Plan around 2027-01-31 spending deadline; suggested internal first-order decision checkpoint 2026-12-15, not an authorization or supplier promise. No purchases, PCB release, HV tests, main merge or target changes.

Integration evidence will be docs/verification/2026-11-18-work-integration-002.md on codex/reva-integrated-prototype-review.

Chat B PROTO-001A provisional sourcing subtask — **NO FORMAL CLAIM / PENDING REVIEW** for Chat C.

Report: https://github.com/mitsu32m/PROJECT-NIXIDORO/blob/codex/reva-integrated-prototype-review/docs/verification/2026-11-18-1302-JST-chatb-proto001-magnetics-sourcing-gate.md
Commit: a86b0c66e0a3890bbb150c212179e4a0954405e9

New procurement bottleneck: Sumida 13324-T086 / JLC C17554736 and LCSC C17554736 showed **0 in stock** at 2026-11-18 retrieval. DigiKey regional listing also 0 with standard lead time 24 weeks; ETA varies by region and is not guaranteed. Sumida's **200V/12mA reference application** is not 205V/16mA qualification: required 3.28W vs reference 2.40W (+36.7%). Würth 750315839 likewise reference 200V/12mA; Japan stock/price unverified. No complete HV controller+magnetics pair qualifies yet.

Requested review: distinguish manufacturer typical/reference from guaranteed performance; check supply-date/stock caveats; ask Work to retain PROTO-001 as open and prioritize exact Japan-region stock and traceable neon/cell sourcing. LV-first and standalone HV staged BOM remain proposals; no procurement approval. No shared-index edits.
